overlays.title: Astronomy API AI Enrichment Overlay
overlays.description: Enriches the Astronomy API with AI-optimized descriptions, usage hints, and examples that help LLMs and AI agents understand and correctly invoke each operation.

overlays.title: Astronomy API Governance Overlay
overlays.description: Adds platform governance metadata to the Astronomy API: data classification labels, rate-limit documentation, and deprecation timeline for legacy operations. Managed by the platform team independently of the API owner.

overlays.title: Astronomy Api Openapi
overlays.description:
Adds deprecation notices and supplementary documentation to the Astronomy REST API without modifying the original OpenAPI specification.

The first patch uses the 'operation' concept-level selector, which maps to the OpenAPI 'operationId' field.

overlays.title: All Odata Selectors
overlays.description:
Demonstrates all OData-specific selectors in a single overlay.

This example shows:
- namespace: Schema-level annotations
- entityType: EntityType definitions
- complexType: ComplexType definitions (OData-specific)
- enumType: EnumType definitions (OData-specific)
- propertyType: Properties, navigation properties, and enum members
- entitySet: EntitySets in EntityContainer
- operation: Actions and Functions
- parameter: Action/Function parameters
- returnType: Action/Function return types

overlays.title: Airline Csn Interop
overlays.description:
Enriches the CSN Interop Airline service with AI-facing descriptions and vocabulary annotations.

For CSN Interop targets (sap-csn-interop-effective-v1), patch data is plain CSN JSON merged
directly into the matched definition or element object. Use 'doc' for human-readable descriptions
and '@AnnotationName' keys for vocabulary annotations (e.g. @EndUserText.label).
entityType selectors use the fully qualified definitions key (e.g. 'AirlineService.Airline').
See: https://sap.github.io/csn-interop-specification/

overlays.title: Weather Mcp Server
overlays.description:
Enriches an MCP server's tool metadata with extended descriptions for AI agent consumption.

The 'operation' selector maps to MCP tool names (tools[].name).
MCP targets use a Specification ID as definitionType (e.g., 'sap.foo:weather-server:v1').

overlays.title: Dispute Agent A2A
overlays.description:
Enriches the Dispute Resolution Agent Card (A2A format) with extended descriptions, usage guidance, and classification metadata without modifying the original Agent Card file.

The 'operation' selector maps to A2A Agent Card skill IDs (skills[].id).

overlays.title: Astronomy Api Openapi Jsonpath
overlays.description: Patches the sample Astronomy OpenAPI metadata using JSONPath selectors only.

overlays.title: Example Service Odata
overlays.description:
Enriches the OData.Demo example service with AI-facing descriptions and deprecation annotations.

Patch data for OData targets (edmx / csdl-json) is expressed in CSDL JSON annotation format:
https://docs.oasis-open.org/odata/odata-csdl-json/v4.01/odata-csdl-json-v4.01.html
Annotation keys use the @TermName convention (e.g. @Core.Description).
This applies to both XML (edmx) and JSON (csdl-json) target files. When the target is EDMX XML,
the overlay merge implementation converts the CSDL JSON patch to equivalent <Annotation> elements.

overlays.title: Business Partner Odata
overlays.description: Enriches OData Business Partner API metadata with extended descriptions and deprecation annotations using concept-level selectors.
